title: Xi Vows to Make AI for All in Debut at China’s Top Tech Summit
title_zh: 习近平誓言让人工智能在中国顶级科技峰会上首次亮相
summary: (Bloomberg) -- President Xi Jinping hailed China’s progress in developing low-cost artificial intelligence, pressing his personal imprint on the country’s rapidly expanding global influence to call for a more open technological order.Most Read from BloombergThailand Scraps Pla...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——国家主席习近平赞扬中国在开发低成本人工智能方面取得的进展，强调他个人对中国迅速扩大的全球影响力的影响，呼吁建立更加开放的技术秩序。

title: DeepSeek Champions China’s Bid to Flood the World With Cheap AI
title_zh: DeepSeek 支持中国用廉价人工智能淹没世界
summary: (Bloomberg) -- On a video conference call from Hangzhou earlier this year, one of China’s hottest startups held a four-hour pitch meeting with potential venture investors that was unusual by almost any measure. Only two representatives per institution were allowed.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——今年早些时候，在杭州举行的一次视频电话会议上，中国最热门的初创公司之一与潜在风险投资者举行了长达四个小时的推介会，这几乎从任何角度来看都是不寻常的。每个机构只允许两名代表。
